top_signals.title: Gold Edges Higher as Traders Assess US Inflation, Fed Remarks
top_signals.summary: Gold edged higher, recouping some losses triggered by a high US inflation print and hawkish remarks from Federal Reserve officials that reinforced expectations of a December rate hike.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78, looks to start trading  Nov. 19, sources say
top_signals.summary: Anthropic's IPO is expected to come roughly five months after Elon Musk took SpaceX public in a record offering.

top_signals.title: Behind Bangladesh’s garment boom, workers cut food, healthcare as wages fall short
top_signals.summary: Recent unrest, some of it violent, forced hundreds of factories to shut down as workers staged protests and clashed with police.

top_signals.title: Democrats Shouldn’t Squander Their Chance to Launch a Foreign Policy Revolution
top_signals.summary: The imperative of ambition in a new Congress.

top_signals.title: Microsoft November 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes 1,235 flaws, Outlook zero-day
top_signals.summary: Today is Microsoft's November 2026 Patch Tuesday, with security updates addressing a record-breaking 1,235 flaws, including one actively exploited Microsoft Outlook zero-day vulnerability. [...]
